_comment: Copy to ~/.config/smart-search/config.json; changes are picked up live. Put the AeroDataBox (RapidAPI) key in ~/.config/smart-search/aerodatabox.key (one line, chmod 600) rather than here; flightStatus.apiKey is only a fallback. Empty weatherCity = the city of your system time zone.
_extraTimeZones: Zones added to clock conversions like "3pm PST" (always shown: local; then these, else UTC). Names ("Beijing", "tokyo", "CET") or IANA ids ("Asia/Shanghai"). Default none.
